content_sections.heading: MNNIT Allahabad Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. ___/Biotech/2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MNNIT Allahabad notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Tech/M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Environmental Biotechnology, Biochemical/chemical engineering, Microbiology, Life Sciences, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Agriculture Biotechnology, and any other related disciplines with GATE/NET qualified Experience: Desirable: research experience in microalgae, biological wastewater treatment, microfluidics and bioreactor, and any other related disciplines with GATE/NET qualified Age limit: Maximum 28 years (as on the last date of application) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PH and women candidates up to 5 years Other conditions: Only Indian nationals may apply Travelling will be required for this project Desirable: Research experience in microalgae, biological wastewater treatment, microfluidics and bioreactor, and any other related disciplines with GATE/NET qualified

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract basis for one year initially, may be extended yearly on performance evaluation till the end of the project Project will end in September 2029 tentatively Position is purely temporary and governed by funding agency rules and service conditions

content_sections.heading: How Will MNNIT Allahabad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting on the basis of merit and need of the project Interview of shortlisted candidates Mere possession of the prescribed qualification does not ensure a call for interview Shortlisted candidates are informed of the interview date by e-mail Shortlisted candidates bring updated CV and original and attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proof of Date of Birth Mark sheets and certificates of all the examinations passed Category certificate, if applicable NET/GATE score card, if passed Experience support, if any Self-attested recent passport size photograph Write-up of understanding of the project objectives in about 300 words

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application on the prescribed format given in the notice. Attach copies of supporting documents. Send it so that it reaches The Dean (Research & Consultancy), Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology, Allahabad, Prayagraj-211004 (U.P.) India. Superscribe the envelope as printed in the notice. Also send a soft copy to [email protected] . Make sure it reaches by 27 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applicants in employment must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview Institute reserves the right to accept applications at any time and consider candidates of exceptional credentials without applications Qualification and experience may be relaxed by the Institute for otherwise exceptional candidates

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) (on contract).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application Form on pages 3 and 4 of the notice) and send it to The Dean (Research & Consultancy), Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology, Allahabad, Prayagraj-211004 (U.P.) India, by post and email, to reach by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years (as on the last date of application). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PH and women candidates up to 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 37,000.00 per month (consolidated) + HRA (if applicable) as per extant SRTMI guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Tech/M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Environmental Biotechnology, Biochemical/chemical engineering, Microbiology, Life Sciences, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Agriculture Biotechnology, and any other related disciplines, with GATE/NET qualified.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian nationals may apply. Travelling will be required for this project.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting on the basis of merit and need of the project. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Mere possession of the prescribed qualification does not ensure a call for interview. Shortlisted candidates are informed of the interview date by e-mail.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis for one year initially, may be extended yearly on performance evaluation till the end of the project. Project will end in September 2029 tentatively. Position is purely temporary and governed by funding agency rules and service conditions.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MNNIT Allahabad, Prayagraj.
